name: Mobecom Limited
summary: Mobecom Limited provides customer engagement technology that delivers end-to-end technology solutions for businesses to engage with their customers in Australia, Singapore, and South Africa. It offers airBux, an enterprise engagement platform that provides a range of modular and suite solutions hosted on-premise and in the cloud, such as payment, rewards management, digital asset exchange, gifting, order-ahead, e-commerce, smart adverts and user-wellness, secure wallet management, tokenised payment, linked card integrated loyalty, and cryptocurrency payments, as well as data services. The company also offers SeventeenHundred, a work and life hub online platform, which provides content, resources, support, and services designed to help employees in the areas of legislation and entitlements, childcare, school and age care, and health and wellbeing. In addition, it offers Paid by Coins, a cryptocurrency exchange platform that provides secure bill payment services for consumers, enabling crypto payments to be automatically converted to Australian dollars and remitted to various billers on the BPAY network or to other Australian bank account; and develops AirCrypto Platform, a blockchain and cryptocurrency exchange platform. Mobecom Limited is headquartered in Surry Hills, Australia.
